description: Two guards, each silent unless its exact condition holds, plus five that are the vibe-ops command itself rather than a shipped script. prefer-mcp (vibe-ops hook prefer-mcp, no script) is TEMPORARY and never decides anything: it names the MCP tool equivalent to a vibe-ops command just run through Bash, and is deleted once the migration it exists for is done. plan-context (vibe-ops hook plan-context, no script) places this repository's plan format and next plan number at the moment a plan is written in plan mode. plan-file (vibe-ops hook plan-file, no script) files an approved plan-mode plan into that repository's project/plans/ and says where it landed. new-context (vibe-ops hook new-context, no script) resolves the repository before a typed /vibe-ops:new starts. task-guard (vibe-ops hook task-guard, no script) refuses to delete a task dossier whose closure ceremony has not run. plan-progress-nudge notices a turn wrote to a repository whose plan is active without touching that plan's living sections. session-state-cleanup deletes this session's own state files at SessionEnd.
